arxiv-2112-11988.title: Reducing Programs to Objects
arxiv-2112-11988.creator: Yegor Bugayenko
arxiv-2112-11988.description: Abstract . C++, Java, C#, Python, Ruby, JavaScript are the most powerful object-oriented programming languages, if language power would be defined as the number of features available for a programmer. EO, on the other hand, is an object-oriented programming language with a reduced set of features: it has nothing by objects and mechanisms of their composition and decoration.

arxiv-2406-15025.title: SiT: Symmetry-Invariant Transformers for Generalisation in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2406-15025.creator: Matthias Weissenbacher, Rishabh Agarwal, Yoshinobu Kawahara
arxiv-2406-15025.description: Abstract An open challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is the effective deployment of a trained policy to new or slightly different situations as well as semantically-similar environments. We introduce S ymmetry- I nvariant T ransformer (SiT), a scalable vision transformer (ViT) that leverages both local and global data patterns in a self-supervised manner to improve generalisation.

arxiv-2411-10776.title: Wronski Pairs of Honeycomb Curves Thanks: The third author is the corresponding author.
arxiv-2411-10776.creator: Laura Casabella, Michael Joswig, Rafael Mohr
arxiv-2411-10776.description: Abstract . We study certain generic systems of real polynomial equations associated with triangulations of convex polytopes and investigate their number of real solutions. Our main focus is set on pairs of plane algebraic curves which form a so-called Wronski system.

arxiv-2506-11312.title: X-ray investigation of the remarkable galaxy group Nest200047
arxiv-2506-11312.creator: Anwesh Majumder ,, A. Simionescu ,, T. Plšek, M. Brienza, E. Churazov, I. Khabibullin, F. Gastaldello, A. Botteon, H. Röttgering, M. Brüggen, N. Lyskova, K. Rajpurohit, R.A. Sunyaev, M.W. Wise
arxiv-2506-11312.description: Abstract Context. Galaxy groups are more susceptible to feedback from the central active galactic nuclei (AGNs) due to their lower gravitational binding energy compared to clusters. This makes them ideal laboratories to study feedback effects on the overall energy and baryonic mass budget. Aims.

arxiv-2507-08676.title: Magic Steady State Production: Non-Hermitian and Stochastic pathways
arxiv-2507-08676.creator: Pablo Martinez-Azcona, Matthieu Sarkis, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Aurélia Chenu
arxiv-2507-08676.description: Abstract Universal quantum computers require states with both entanglement and non-stabilizerness, the latter property being commonly known as quantum magic . Here, we introduce a protocol that prepares magic steady states by leveraging non-Hermitian dynamics, which, contrary to unitary dynamics, can host pure-state attractors.

pmc-11528663.title: Novel image-analytic approach reveals new insights in fine-tuning of slime mould network adaptation
pmc-11528663.creator: Philipp Rosina, Martin Grube
pmc-11528663.description: This study introduces a novel methodology to explore the network dynamics of Physarum polycephalum, an organism celebrated for its remarkable adaptive capabilities. We used two innovative techniques to analyse its growth behaviour and network modifications under stress conditions, including starvation and differential epinephrine exposures. The first method provided a quantitative assessment of growth and exploration over time.

pmc-11642073.title: Constitutive Modelling Analysis and Hot Deformation Process of AISI 8822H Steel
pmc-11642073.creator: Khaled Elanany, Wojciech Borek, Saad Ebied
pmc-11642073.description: This study used the Gleeble 3800 thermomechanical simulator to examine the hot deformation characteristics of AISI 8822H steel. The main goal was to understand the alloy’s behaviour under various thermomechanical settings, emphasising temperature ranges between 1173 K and 1323 K and strain rates from 0.01 s−1 to 10 s−1.

pmc-12139653.title: Juvenile Mitral Stenosis Presenting as Acute Pulmonary Edema Treated with Balloon Mitral Valvotomy
pmc-12139653.creator: Newton Ghosh, Priyavardhan Mishra, Kshitij Balwaik, Anant Patil
pmc-12139653.description: Juvenile mitral stenosis is defined by poor left atrial emptying due to limited opening of the mitral-valve orifice in patients under the age of 20 years. Balloon mitral valvotomy is the current treatment of choice for juvenile mitral stenosis. Here we report a case of a 14-year-old female presenting with signs of acute pulmonary oedema.

pmc-12643734.title: Causal insights into immune cell profiles, plasma metabolites, and bladder cancer: A Mendelian randomization approach
pmc-12643734.creator: Juan Yang, Zhangxiao Xu, Bo Tao, Yuan Zhao, Yiran Ma, Yuanjian Niu, Yunpeng He, Jian Wu, Lijun Wang, Zitao Zhong
pmc-12643734.description: This study aimed to investigate the causal associations between immune cells, plasma metabolites, and bladder cancer (BC) using Mendelian randomization (MR). Utilizing summary data from genome-wide association studies, the study examined the causal effects among 731 immune cell phenotypes, 1400 plasma metabolites, and BC.

pmc-13576077.title: Two New Polyketides From Streptomyces sp. SA61: Isolation, Structure Elucidation, and Insecticidal Activity Against Bemisia tabaci
pmc-13576077.creator: Pengfei Cui, Jiajun Chen, Zhaoyu Zhu, Fei Liu, Zhiguo Yu
pmc-13576077.description: To discover novel green bio‐based insecticidal lead compounds, six polyketides, including two new compounds, strekingmycin I (5) and strekingmycin J (6), together with four known analogues, were isolated and identified from the fermentation products of earthworm gut‐derived Streptomyces sp. SA61. Their structures were established by comprehensive spectroscopic analysis, including NMR, HR‐ESI‐MS, and single‐crystal x‐ray diffraction.
